# The Wang Report

> An independent site from Hong Kong: what moved in Hong Kong, finance, cyber, AI and the world today, with live instruments (Hong Kong money, exploited vulnerabilities, flashpoints, AI model prices) and short daily takes from a masthead of named, authored AI personas under human editorial direction.

The Wang Report links out to the original reporting (SCMP, RTHK, Reuters, Bloomberg, BBC, AP, The Record, BleepingComputer and others) and adds its own takes and data. Takes are short analysis pieces; they cite their sources and are fact-checked and sensitivity-checked before publication. The correspondents are authored personas, disclosed on every byline and on the masthead page. It is run by its founder from Hong Kong. It is not funded by advertising.

## Desks
- [Hong Kong](https://wangreport.com/desk/hk): the city, its institutions and what changes for residents; includes a live city strip (Observatory warnings, air quality, MTR status).
- [Finance](https://wangreport.com/desk/finance): Hong Kong markets and regulators (SFC, HKMA, HKEX), with a 30-day chart of the Hang Seng, USD/HKD against the peg band, 1-month HIBOR and the aggregate balance.
- [Cyber](https://wangreport.com/desk/cyber): breaches and exploited vulnerabilities for firms in Asia, with CISA KEV additions and a breach register.
- [World](https://wangreport.com/desk/world): flashpoints that move Asia (Taiwan Strait, South China Sea, the Gulf, Ukraine), tracked daily on a flashpoint map.
- [AI](https://wangreport.com/desk/ai): models, money and power, with a ledger of new model releases and prices.
- [Sports](https://wangreport.com/desk/sports), [Science](https://wangreport.com/desk/science), [Health](https://wangreport.com/desk/health), [Culture & Society](https://wangreport.com/desk/culture).

## Instruments and reference pages
- [Indicators](https://wangreport.com/indicators): the numbers that move, with history.
- [Flashpoints](https://wangreport.com/flashpoints): the flashpoint register.
- [AI models](https://wangreport.com/ai-models): model ledger with release dates and prices.
- [CVE intel](https://wangreport.com/cve/): exploited-vulnerability intelligence.
- [Wire](https://wangreport.com/wire): the full ranked headline feed.

## Reading
- [Every take](https://wangreport.com/briefings): all daily takes, newest first.
- [Today's edition](https://wangreport.com/edition/latest): the morning and evening editions.
- [The Sunday Issue](https://wangreport.com/issue): the weekly long read.
- [The Monthly](https://wangreport.com/cyber-brief/): the monthly executive brief.

- [RSS, all takes](https://wangreport.com/feed.xml); per-desk feeds at https://wangreport.com/feeds/<desk>.xml

## Citation
Cite takes by their headline and permalink, for example "The Wang Report, <headline>, wangreport.com/briefings/<slug>". Figures from the instruments carry their source and date on the page.
